XML.ReadFromFile File: $'''C:\\Users\\dusanku\\Music\\exercise4_xml.txt''' Encoding: XML.FileEncoding.DefaultEncoding XmlDocument=> XmlDocument
XML.ExecuteXPathQuery.ExecuteXPath XmlDocument: XmlDocument XPathQuery: $'''/Artikli/Artikal''' XPathResults=> ArtikalNodes
Variables.CreateNewList List=> ArtikalList
LOOP FOREACH CurrentNode IN ArtikalNodes
    SET CurrArtikal TO {{ }}
    BLOCK 'Extract Id'
ON BLOCK ERROR

END
        XML.ExecuteXPathQuery.ExecuteXPathAndGetFirstValueOnly XmlDocument: CurrentNode XPathQuery: $'''/Artikal/Id''' XPathResult=> XPathIdResult
        XML.GetXmlElementValue.GetElementValueAsNumeric Document: XPathIdResult NumericValue=> elId
        SET CurrArtikal['Id'] TO elId
    END
    BLOCK 'Extract Name'
ON BLOCK ERROR

END
        XML.ExecuteXPathQuery.ExecuteXPathAndGetFirstValueOnly XmlDocument: CurrentNode XPathQuery: $'''/Artikal/Naziv''' XPathResult=> XPathNazivResult
        XML.GetXmlElementValue.GetElementValue Document: XPathNazivResult TextValue=> elName
        SET CurrArtikal['Name'] TO elName
    END
    BLOCK 'Extract Cena'
ON BLOCK ERROR

END
        XML.ExecuteXPathQuery.ExecuteXPathAndGetFirstValueOnly XmlDocument: CurrentNode XPathQuery: $'''/Artikal/Cena''' XPathResult=> XPathCenaResult
        XML.GetXmlElementValue.GetElementValueAsNumeric Document: XPathCenaResult NumericValue=> elCena
        SET CurrArtikal['Cena'] TO elCena
    END
    BLOCK 'Extract Kolicina'
ON BLOCK ERROR

END
        XML.ExecuteXPathQuery.ExecuteXPathAndGetFirstValueOnly XmlDocument: CurrentNode XPathQuery: $'''/Artikal/Kolicina''' XPathResult=> XPathKolicinaResult
        XML.GetXmlElementValue.GetElementValueAsNumeric Document: XPathKolicinaResult NumericValue=> elKolicina
        SET CurrArtikal['Kolicina'] TO elKolicina
    END
    BLOCK 'Extract Opis'
ON BLOCK ERROR

END
        XML.ExecuteXPathQuery.ExecuteXPathAndGetFirstValueOnly XmlDocument: CurrentNode XPathQuery: $'''/Artikal/Opis''' XPathResult=> XPathOpisResult
        XML.GetXmlElementValue.GetElementValue Document: XPathOpisResult TextValue=> elOpis
        SET CurrArtikal['Opis'] TO elOpis
    END
    Variables.AddItemToList Item: CurrArtikal List: ArtikalList
END
Display.ShowMessageDialog.ShowMessage Title: $'''LIST OF ARTIKLI''' Message: ArtikalList Icon: Display.Icon.None Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False
